exports.text: Platform basics: predicate reports any UV hub variant; blade iterator walks zero to possible count; GPA shift and minimum hub revision come from hub state.

Address family locates range record by masked key and derives base; converts socket physical to network id and kernel pointer to network id or global address; reverses global to socket physical; decodes global to node partition and offset with direct or range fallback; maps socket to node and partition to socket with bias or identity; builds virtual address from partition plus offset; converts APIC id to partition with optional socket remap.
MMR windows build global 32-bit global 64-bit and local addresses from base plus positioned partition bits and offset with paired quad and byte read and write helpers.

Topology helpers report blade processor numbers blade to node node to blade CPU to blade blade to partition and memory node possible and online CPU counts CPU and node to partition and total possible blades.
Current hub NMI block comes from local CPU record with per CPU hub and CPU variants.

hazards.text: Range lookup failure is fatal: reports missing address and table position then halts with no fallback.

Y word dense 1 to 61: HC 1-11 KT RH0 RH1 LH0 LH1 LH2 LH3 XB RDM NI0 NI1; G0 12-25 LB KT RH0 RH1 LH0 LH1 LH2 LH3 XB RDM RT0 RT1 NI0 NI1; G1 26-39 same order; 40 shutdown 41-56 LB IRQ0-15 57 L1 NMI 58 stop 59 ASIC-to-L1 60 L1-to-ASIC 61 LA trigger; each single bit.

4 word sparse: 1 KT HC; 10 KT G0; 17-20 RTQ0-3 G0; 21-22 NI0-1 G0; 23-36 G1 LB KT RH LH0 LH1 GR0 GR1 XB RTQ0-3 NI0-1; 37 shutdown 38-53 LB IRQ0-15 54 L1 NMI 55 stop 56 ASIC-to-L1 57 L1-to-ASIC 58 LA 59 IPI 60-63 EXTIO0-3; each single bit.

UV2 and UV3 share identical 1-58 map: 1 QP HC; 10 QP G0; 17-19 RT NI0 NI1 G0; 20-30 G1 LB QP RH LH0 LH1 GR0 GR1 XB RT NI0 NI1; 31 shutdown; 32-47 LB IRQ0-15; 48 L1 NMI 49 stop 50 ASIC-to-L1 51 L1-to-ASIC 52 LA 53 IPI 54-57 EXTIO0-3 58 profile; each single bit.
Generic EXTIO0 selects bit60 on UV4 and bit54 on UV2 and UV3, else zero mask with negative shift meaning absent.

Reserved ranges and gaps must be preserved and not interpreted; Y and 4 maps clash with same numbers meaning different sources and IRQ blocks at 41 versus 38 so wrong table misattributes; address and MMR helpers rely on external physical-virtual translation 64-bit and byte register access and critical reporting.

invariants.text: Partition node derives from network id with configured shift and mask; network id rebuilds by merging global extra bits and shifting back; physical to global applies low remap then mode shuffling or id insertion; top two global bits set means MMR space.
UV IRQ and MMR headers use single inclusion guards.

Each shift and mask pair denotes one bit; masks select only that bit so updates preserve others; within each generation shifts are distinct and non overlapping; Y names 1 to 61 contiguously, 4 names 1 then 10 then 17 to 63 with gaps.

locks.text: Each hub NMI block carries its own raw spinlock for NMI register handling alongside atomics; no sleeping lock shown.

state_machines.text: CPU NMI progress moves among outside inside dumping and dump complete.

structs.text: APIC identity is a 64-bit view readable as one integer or two decode groups for local APIC and partition node with mask shift and reserved padding.
Hub NMI block holds spinlock presence owner read and true atomics last value and flags; CPU block links to hub and holds state plus ping and query counters.
IO APIC route entry packs vector delivery and destination modes status polarity trigger mask reserved gaps and 32-bit destination into 64 bits; affinity orders all node and CPU.

Event word is a union of raw word plus generation views: generic with only LB hard error at bit0; extended common grouping hard and group-zero errors low; younger common with full hard group-zero group-one shutdown 16 LB IRQs NMI stop clock ASIC pair and trigger; UV5 prefix follows younger ordering through LB IRQ 10.

Local MMR base 0xfa000000 32MiB UV2 to UV5; 32-bit global 0xfc000000 32MiB UV2 to UV3 else zero; 64-bit base and shift from hub; GRU 0x4000000; 32-bit part bit15; legacy shift26; APIC 0x002D0E00 shift6; bus 0x1c00000 4MiB; SCIR 64B tail with beat 0x01 act 0x02 1HZ; BIOS scratch anchors TSC shift10 alt16 mask3 and NMI shift63.

Generations UV2 1 UV3 2 UV4 4 UV4A 8 UV5 16; UVX is 2 to 4 UVY is 5; enable bit63; parts UV1 0x88a5 UV2 0x8eb8 alt 0x1111 UV3 0x9578 alt 0x4321 UV4 0x99a1 UV5 0xa171; event0 at 0x70000 with single-bit hard and address errors.
